title: StS2 - La Rata Remix
description:
[h1]The king has been watching.[/h1]
La Rata Remix brings controlled chaos, new cards, shared treasure drama and an optional royal endgame to Slay the Spire 2. Built for 1-4 players, with seeded encounter changes that scale with party size and act progression.

[h2]A different climb[/h2]
[list]
[*]40 encounter twist types plus additional enemies: armor, retaliation, debuffs, on-hit effects and unusual combinations within a shared difficulty budget.
[*]A potion-throwing goblin visits selected fights between rounds. In co-op, every living player receives a different eligible potion, one after another.
[*]La Rata occasionally plays a hidden card from offscreen. A bright emerald marker warns you: defeat the marked enemy before its turn to prevent the intervention.
[*]Every player starts with Bowler Hat, Potion Belt and White Beast Statue: more gold, two extra potion slots and guaranteed potion rewards after combat.
[/list]

[h2]The Royal Collection[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ten new illustrated neutral cards, Cleanse and five playable royal prize cards, all with upgrades.
[*]Six booster relics, available to every class. Open five facedown cards with rarity glows and individual reveals, then keep any number. La Rata packs have a 20% chance to contain a playable boss-card variant.
[*]Five combo relics supporting exhaust, Powers, mixed card types, potions and discard.
[*]Well wins contested chest relics against players without it; multiple Well holders have equal chances. A Thousand Cuts allows repeated shop removals at the normal increasing price.
[*]Choose Rock, Paper or Scissors privately when competing for chest relics. Solo chests offer three relic choices.
[/list]

[h2]YOU ARE NOT PREPARED[/h2]
After the regular finale, choose whether to enter the bonus path. Everyone must agree in co-op. Face the Kingsguard, four dark knights who shield, reinforce and heal one another, then challenge La Rata and his court. The king uses a 20-card illustrated deck and five randomized combat relic effects. Your regular victory remains secured if the bonus challenge defeats you; defeating La Rata leads to the normal ending.

[h2]Installation and updating[/h2]
[b]Requires Slay the Spire 2 v0.107.1 and BaseLib 3.4.7. Current mod version: 0.8.2.[/b]
Subscribe to this item and the required BaseLib item. Enable both in the game's mod menu and restart when prompted. Remove --nomods from Steam launch options if present.

[b]Switching from a manual install?[/b] Close the game and move the old mods/LaRata folder outside the game's mods directory. The native loader prioritizes a local copy over the Workshop version, so leaving it there can prevent updates from taking effect.

[b]Start a new run after updating. All co-op players need identical game and mod versions.[/b] Do not switch versions during an active run. New starting relics are not added retroactively to old saves. La Rata does not migrate or reset your profiles. All mod-added text is English.

[h2]Development status[/h2]
Targeted solo and four-local-client checks cover the current package; they are not a guarantee of full-run balance, Internet co-op or compatibility with every other mod. Please include your game/mod versions and relevant logs when reporting a problem.

[url=https://github.com/Captain-Boba/StS2-La-Rata-Remix]Source, documentation and issue tracker[/url]
[url=https://github.com/Captain-Boba/StS2-La-Rata-Remix/releases/tag/v0.8.2]Version 0.8.2 patch notes and manual download[/url]

Original mod code is MIT-licensed. Raster artwork and branding are excluded from that license. Mod-owned illustrations were generated with OpenAI image generation; the original royal laugh was generated with ElevenLabs. Native game models and animations are referenced from your installed game, not redistributed.
changeNote:
- Add the Kingsguard: four emerald-armored knights with distinct support roles, native animations and coordinated combat mechanics.
- Double Kingsguard damage and triple Plating grants; heal all guards for 10% max HP on Herald turn two and the most injured ally for 25% on Armorer turn three.
- Add hidden royal interventions with a bright emerald warning marker, native card-play presentation and a ratlike laugh; defeat the marked enemy to cancel the card.
- Expand La Rata's deck to 20 illustrated cards with healing, armor, debuffs, status generation and new attack combinations.
- Add ten illustrated neutral cards and five playable royal prize cards, each with an upgrade.
- Add six class-independent booster relics containing five distinct cards, with a 20% royal-prize chance in La Rata packs.
- Add interactive pack openings with facedown cards, rarity glows, flip animations and individual reveals; allow keeping any number of cards.
- Preserve pending booster contents across native checkpoints and retain opened packs as relic mementos.
- Add Ashen Spool, Crown Capacitor, Crossroads Compass, Bottled Echo and Smuggler's Thread to enable exhaust, Power, mixed-card, potion and discard combos.
- Make Bottled Echo grant 1 Strength and draw 2 cards immediately after drinking a potion in combat.
- Set Borrowed Breath+ to heal 6 HP and draw 3 cards.
- Set Emerald Ward to cost 2 Energy and grant all living players 5 Block and 1 Energy, upgraded to 10 Block and 2 Energy.
- Rework playable Scepter Storm to apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable before dealing 10 damage, upgraded to 2 of each and 20 damage.
- Extend Cleanse to remove Curse cards from all combat piles while preserving Status cards and permanent decks.
- Lighten custom card frames with jade and emerald highlights, correct Energy icons and recolor Regent Booster orange and gold.
- Expand encounter variety to 40 twist types plus reinforcements, including retaliation, reflection, ally-death reactions, Doom synergy and Skill punishment.
- Scale twist budgets and defensive effects with act progression, and increase additional-enemy frequency within budget and formation limits.
- Expand the goblin pool to 58 compatible native potions with conditional eligibility and sequential co-op effects; shorten his initial standing pause.
- Grant every player Bowler Hat, Potion Belt and White Beast Statue at new-run start, replacing separate gold and potion-capacity modifiers.
- Replace the bonus invitation portrait with a full-screen throne room showing La Rata's glowing eyes in shadow.
- Add pulsing emerald energy to the large Kingsguard knights' breastplates.
- Update content documentation, installation guidance and artwork provenance for version 0.8.2.
